@block:githubTokenTip:
With it filled in, every GitHub request carries it: the version-check quota rises from 60 requests/hour to 5000 requests/hour, so hitting the limit becomes rare.
Token or not, once a new version is found you can always click “Download” and let the app fetch it — the token only affects the version-check quota, never the download.
It only needs read access to public repositories; the token lives in the local encrypted config and is never uploaded or written to logs.
